_README: Academic (credit-hour) and tuition figures below are sourced and dated to the 2025-2026 UNT Registrar Transfer Guides and UNT Financial Aid & Scholarships, retrieved 2026-07-31. Salary figures (median_starting_salary, salary_source, salary_source_date) remain PLACEHOLDER — College Scorecard integration is Stage 4 and untouched here. Every field keeps its own source/date pair; a credit requirement must never cite the tuition or salary source, and vice versa.

tuition.full_time_semester_estimate_source: UNT Financial Aid & Scholarships, Undergraduate Cost of Attendance — 2025-2026 resident Tuition and Fees estimate of $12,092 for the academic year (Fall + Spring, 15 hours/semester = 30 hours/year), divided by 2 semesters. financialaid.unt.edu/undergraduate.html
tuition.below_full_time_note: UNT charges tuition and mandatory fees hourly for enrollment below 12 semester credit hours in a term, and uses a flat rate from 12 up through 15 hours. This engine does not have a verified per-hour rate for below-full-time enrollment; use UNT's official Tuition Estimator (https://estimatemytuition.unt.edu/) for a precise below-full-time figure.
